enum:
force-renew-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but the server sends a DHCP FORCERENEW message to the client, because an option has changed for this client.
held:The IP address has been used by the client but the lease has timed out. The address is held so that the same client can acquire this address when requesting a new lease.
internal-held:The IP address has been used by local pool management system but the lease is currently not active. The address is now in the hold list so that the local pool management system client can get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.
internal-offered:The IP address has been offered via the local pool management system. The client still has to acknowledge this offer.
internal-orphan:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use. There is however no configured subnet to which this lease belongs, because it has been removed or because this lease was installed through dual-homing.
internal:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use.
offered:The IP address was offered to the client. The client still has to acknowledge the offer by sending a DHCP request.
remove-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but it is no longer available in the configured IP address ranges. The server sends a FORCERENEW message to the client. When the client sends a renewal DHCP request message, it will be rejected.
stable:The IP address is now in use by the client.
sticky:The IP address is reserved for the client and will remain reserved until the reservation for it is cleared.  The client will get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.

enum:
force-renew-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but the server sends a DHCP FORCERENEW message to the client, because an option has changed for this client.
held:The IP address has been used by the client but the lease has timed out. The address is held so that the same client can acquire this address when requesting a new lease.
internal-held:The IP address has been used by local pool management system but the lease is currently not active. The address is now in the hold list so that the local pool management system client can get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.
internal-offered:The IP address has been offered via the local pool management system. The client still has to acknowledge this offer.
internal-orphan:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use. There is however no configured subnet to which this lease belongs, because it has been removed or because this lease was installed through dual-homing.
internal:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use.
offered:The IP address was offered to the client. The client still has to acknowledge the offer by sending a DHCP request.
remove-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but it is no longer available in the configured IP address ranges. The server sends a FORCERENEW message to the client. When the client sends a renewal DHCP request message, it will be rejected.
stable:The IP address is now in use by the client.
sticky:The IP address is reserved for the client and will remain reserved until the reservation for it is cleared.  The client will get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.

enum:
force-renew-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but the server sends a DHCP FORCERENEW message to the client, because an option has changed for this client.
held:The IP address has been used by the client but the lease has timed out. The address is held so that the same client can acquire this address when requesting a new lease.
internal-held:The IP address has been used by local pool management system but the lease is currently not active. The address is now in the hold list so that the local pool management system client can get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.
internal-offered:The IP address has been offered via the local pool management system. The client still has to acknowledge this offer.
internal-orphan:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use. There is however no configured subnet to which this lease belongs, because it has been removed or because this lease was installed through dual-homing.
internal:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use.
offered:The IP address was offered to the client. The client still has to acknowledge the offer by sending a DHCP request.
remove-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but it is no longer available in the configured IP address ranges. The server sends a FORCERENEW message to the client. When the client sends a renewal DHCP request message, it will be rejected.
stable:The IP address is now in use by the client.
sticky:The IP address is reserved for the client and will remain reserved until the reservation for it is cleared.  The client will get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.

enum:
force-renew-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but the server sends a DHCP FORCERENEW message to the client, because an option has changed for this client.
held:The IP address has been used by the client but the lease has timed out. The address is held so that the same client can acquire this address when requesting a new lease.
internal-held:The IP address has been used by local pool management system but the lease is currently not active. The address is now in the hold list so that the local pool management system client can get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.
internal-offered:The IP address has been offered via the local pool management system. The client still has to acknowledge this offer.
internal-orphan:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use. There is however no configured subnet to which this lease belongs, because it has been removed or because this lease was installed through dual-homing.
internal:The IP address has been leased via the local pool management system and is now in use.
offered:The IP address was offered to the client. The client still has to acknowledge the offer by sending a DHCP request.
remove-pending:The IP address is in use by the client, but it is no longer available in the configured IP address ranges. The server sends a FORCERENEW message to the client. When the client sends a renewal DHCP request message, it will be rejected.
stable:The IP address is now in use by the client.
sticky:The IP address is reserved for the client and will remain reserved until the reservation for it is cleared.  The client will get the exactly same IP address again upon the next request for a lease.
